Q: Remote WCF debugging is failing (.NET 4.8) A:

While difficult to find, the solution was easy.

It turned out that I'd rebuilt the website locally since publishing, thereby creating a new (non-matching) .pdb file.

Q: Fluent UI in Outlook Add-In has suddenly stopped working A:

Well, I get to answer my own question. Alas, our source repository was not tied to a specific version of the fluent web-components library. And the 3.0.0 release went live yesterday, which meant our add-in was picking up the new version with apparently is not backwards compatible (it is a major version change) by a lot...

Q: Error uploading a file from the client side A:

The behavior is expected as request is closed/disposed when it is "complete" - in this case when you return true. Request/response related objects will not be usable past that point which is exactly what you trying to do by delaying reading from input stream.

Fix:

  • make server side code to normally store file as part of the request but on client side don't wait for result
  • read input stream into MemoryStream and save that to a file. May not work for large files.

Q: Passing JSON data to a webservice A:

Try this:

data: "{ categoryName  :'" + $('#categoryName').val() + "' , categoryDescription: '" + $('#categoryDescription').val() + "' }",

Don't forget to update CreateHelpDeskCategory to accept both arguments.

To add a third argument, use the following:

data: "{ categoryName:'" + + $('#categoryName').val() + "' , categoryDescription: '" + + $('#categoryDescription').val() + "', modifiedBy:'jsmith' }",

Q: Programmatically accessing Data in an ASP.NET 2.0 Repeater A:

If you can afford a smidge more overhead in the generation, go for DataList and use the DataKeys property, which will save the data fields you need.

You could also use labels in each of your table cells and be able to reference items with:

e.Item.FindControl("LabelID")
